SELECT 'O' || LPAD(SEQ_ORD_NO.NEXTVAL, 9, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_ORD_H (ORD_NO, CUST_NO, ORD_DT, ORD_STAT_CD, TOT_AMT, REG_ID) VALUES (#ordNo#, #custNo#, SYSDATE, '10', #totAmt#, #regId#)

INSERT INTO TB_ORD_D (ORD_NO, ITEM_SEQ, PRD_CD, ORD_QTY, UNIT_PRC) SELECT #newOrdNo#, S.ITEM_SEQ, S.PRD_CD, S.ORD_QTY, P.SALE_PRC FROM TB_ORD_D S JOIN TB_PRD_M P ON P.PRD_CD = S.PRD_CD WHERE S.ORD_NO = #srcOrdNo#
